project.description: Lium (lium.io) is an agent-first GPU cloud on Bittensor Subnet 51. It enables users to rent NVIDIA GPUs through the web interface, command-line interface, SDK, or API. GPU providers earn 95% of rental revenue plus bonuses. The project provides documentation at https://docs.lium.io and a provider portal at https://provider.lium.io. Its CLI and SDK are available at https://github.com/Datura-ai/lium. Official community and support channels are https://discord.gg/lium, https://x.com/lium_io, and support@lium.io.
